title: Reimagine Your Temperament
coreMove: Stop treating distractibility as a fixed identity and choose the next behavior that proves a different self-story.
sourcePressure: The chapter closes the internal-trigger section by replacing fatalistic self-stories with a behavior-based view of attention.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would sort people into personality types rather than loosening the identity story that grants permission to drift.

hook: Reimagine Your Temperament as a labeled topic opener
counterintuition: phones are not the problem by itself
tryThisNow: set a timer and notice your distractions
examples: reused old-package object-anchor shell from earlier Indistractable run

exampleSpecs.domain: city arborist writing inspection notes after storms
exampleSpecs.audience: arborist who says paperwork is impossible for field people
exampleSpecs.stakes: unsafe limbs remain unprioritized if identity excuses the report
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he crosses out 'not a desk person' and uploads three tree photos before leaving the truck
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A storm limb photo is open beside a tree-risk tablet.

exampleSpecs.audience: stagehand who calls himself old-school to avoid digital cues
exampleSpecs.stakes: opening night cues depend on a system he has dismissed
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he says 'old-school means reliable' and enters the first light cue himself
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A cue sheet is taped next to a glowing lighting console.

exampleSpecs.audience: beekeeper who treats scattered notes as part of being intuitive
exampleSpecs.stakes: hive health trends disappear without records
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she changes the story from free-form to observant and logs the mite count before checking messages
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A hive tool rests across a yellow inspection card.

exampleSpecs.domain: food-truck owner reconciling cash after service
exampleSpecs.audience: owner who says creative operators hate numbers
exampleSpecs.stakes: cash variance hides spoilage and pricing mistakes
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she calls the count part of protecting the menu and sorts the first register envelope
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A register envelope sits beside a sauce-splattered menu board.

exampleSpecs.audience: student who says she is impulsive under pressure
exampleSpecs.stakes: unsafe go decisions become more likely if the label stays
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she writes 'careful pilot' at the top of the weather worksheet and calls the no-go threshold before checking forecasts
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A wind sock diagram lies under a weather worksheet.

exampleSpecs.audience: volunteer who jokes that artists cannot do records
exampleSpecs.stakes: grant reimbursement fails if the joke runs the evening
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he treats the receipt scan as evidence of the troupe he protects and finishes one folder
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A ticket-roll receipt is flattened beside a grant folder.
